title: Waltham man indicted in connection with fatal assault
author: Boston.com Staff
bullets: Local News Nicholas Dagostino, 23, died at Lahey Burlington Medical Center on May 29, officials said.
A Waltham man has been indicted on manslaughter charges in connection with the fatal assault of 23-year-old Nicholas Dagostino of Waltham, according to Middlesex District Attorney Marian Ryan.
Ryan and Waltham Chief of Police Kevin O’Connell confirmed the indictment of 31-year-old Timothy Scalisi of Waltham in a statement Friday.
